mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_request ( ai_decision_id, account_no, broker_type, stock_code, order_side, order_type, order_price, order_quantity, order_amount, order_status, idempotency_key, request_reason, broker_order_no, requested_at ) VALUES ( #{aiDecisionId}, #{accountNo}, #{brokerType}, #{stockCode}, #{orderSide}, #{orderType}, #{orderPrice}, #{orderQuantity}, #{orderAmount}, #{orderStatus}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestReason}, #{brokerOrderNo}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, ai_decision_id, account_no, broker_type, stock_code, order_side, order_type, order_price, order_quantity, order_amount, order_status, idempotency_key, request_reason, broker_order_no, requested_at, updated_at FROM order_request WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, ai_decision_id, account_no, broker_type, stock_code, order_side, order_type, order_price, order_quantity, order_amount, order_status, idempotency_key, request_reason, broker_order_no, requested_at, updated_at FROM order_request WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE order_request SET broker_order_no = #{brokerOrderNo}, order_status = #{orderStatus}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE order_request SET order_status = #{orderStatus}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, ai_decision_id, account_no, broker_type, stock_code, order_side, order_type, order_price, order_quantity, order_amount, order_status, idempotency_key, request_reason, broker_order_no, requested_at, updated_at FROM order_request WHERE broker_order_no = #{brokerOrderNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM order_request WHERE ai_decision_id = #{aiDecisionId} AND order_side = 'SELL' AND request_reason LIKE CONCAT('SELL[', #{trigger}, ']%') AND order_status IN ('READY', 'ORDERED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'FILLED')

SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM order_request WHERE ai_decision_id = #{aiDecisionId} AND order_side = 'SELL' AND request_reason LIKE CONCAT('SELL[', #{trigger}, ']%') AND requested_at >= CURDATE() AND requested_at < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND order_status IN ('READY', 'ORDERED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'FILLED')
